title: agentdiff 0.1.18
excerpt: agentdiff hooks into major AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, OpenCode, Gemini) and writes permanent, commit-scoped attribution records capturing agent name, model, prompt excerpt, and exact line ranges. It provides git-blame-style line-level attribution and stats, installable globally via a configure command.
